entries.meaning: Dialog - modal dialog/prompt/chooser/toast state
The TUI framework's own core-engine namespace
Pane - per-pane layout state (row/col/width/height/children/scroll, in _TUI_P_* fields). Also reused for "Program" in tui_sync.sh's TUI_SYNC_P_ADD/UPDATE/SAME/REMOVE diff-plan arrays.
Widget - per-widget state (type/pane/value/label/action, in _TUI_W_* fields)
Widget Screen Row - resolved draw position from _tui._widget_pos
Widget Screen Col - resolved draw position from _tui._widget_pos
Widget Screen Width - resolved draw size from _tui._widget_pos
Widget Screen Height - resolved draw size from _tui._widget_pos
Text - prefix for the text-editing engine's per-widget state (input/password/textarea)
cursor position
selection anchor (-1 = no selection)
horizontal scroll offset
wanted column - remembered column for up/down nav across shorter lines
rows shown - visible height of a textarea
keep-cursor-in-view-on-next-draw flag (0 after a wheel scroll)
last edit kind (type/move/undo) - coalesces consecutive keystrokes into one undo step
last edit cursor position - compared to detect a break in typing
line-start byte offsets, cached by _tui_text.index
undo stack: value
undo stack: cursor position
undo stack: entry count
redo stack: value
redo stack: cursor position
redo stack: entry count
field geometry of the widget's last draw (origin row/col, width, rows) - used for mouse-click-to-cursor mapping
paint value - one rendered/painted line of a text widget
selection start offset
selection end offset
line count
prefix for select/list/table-style widget extension state
selected index
scroll top row
table column headers
rows/height
needs-redraw-in-view flag (mirrors TXF)
per-widget items array, via nameref _WXI_<id>
internal state for lib/tui_api.sh (the public callback/app helper API) - e.g. scheduled tui.every/tui.after jobs, tui.watch background jobs
target pane for a tui.watch background job
tui.watch refresh interval, in seconds
tui.watch shell command being run in the background
tui.watch output buffer
tui.watch background process PID
list of active tui.watch job ids
command Palette UI state (the pop-up command bar)
plugin registry state (loaded <script> plugins)
Theme Parse - staging arrays for one freshly-parsed theme/CSS file, before _tui.theme_commit merges it into the committed _TUI_CLASS_* tables
Resolve UI - the interactive conflict-resolution dialog loop for tui.sync.resolve_ui
the dapk package-manager subsystem's own short name (dabt pkg / dapk.* functions)
Package Manager - pacman/apt/dnf/zypper/apk/brew install command lines
Version CoMPare result (-1|0|1, semver precedence)
Build Item - one `include file|dir` entry being accumulated for dabt build's manifest
Pane Current - the pane keyboard actions start from (focused pane → focused widget's pane → hovered pane)
NAV Panes - visible leaf panes worth keyboard-focusing (Tab/arrow navigation)
REVerse Keys - command → key-hint lookup, the inverse of the normal key→command bind table
Bind List - flattened rows of all active keybindings
mouse hit-test result - which pane the pointer is currently over
TR Value - fork-free scratch return value for terminal_renderer.sh's `_v`-suffixed helpers (avoids a subshell per call)
Terminal Renderer
Select Graphic Rendition - the standard ANSI escape-code family for color/bold/underline/etc (not DABT-specific)
scratch var holding one resolved SGR string before it's copied into a field
Background Execution - tui.exec's tracked background-process instances (iid -> command/PID/pane/status/…)
Toast - the parallel arrays behind tui.notify's toast notifications
Publish - dapk.publish's GitHub-release state (repo/tag/name/body/assets/…)
DAPK Collect - staging state while gathering files for a package
User Bind - user-defined keybindings (as opposed to code/default binds), serialized to/from config
Markdown - the markdown renderer's tables and per-render scratch (_TUI_MD_*, _MD_*): styles, link/image tables, row output
Tui Validate - the markup validator's rule tables, walk state and findings (_TV_*)
Tui Validate Rules - scratch state of the default validator rules (_TVR_*: grid, tab order, rail and layer checks)
Resize - pane-resize handles and the drag in progress (_RZ_* scratch, _TUI_RZ_* state)
Hit Zone - registered mouse zones plus hover and dirty state (_TUI_HZ_*). In _TC_HZ it is the horizontal edge glyph of a border style
Layer - per-layer fields of windows, popups, modals and toasts (_TUI_L_ROW/COL/H/W/F/..., indexed by layer id)
Layout - results and scratch of the size-spec resolver (_LY_R cells, _LY_SPECS, _LY_MAXS)
Tui Job - background job tables keyed by job id (_TJ_PID, _TJ_FILES, _TJ_START, _TJ_DELAY, _TJ_SHOWN)
Refresh - signatures and scratch of tui.page.refresh's incremental rebuild (_RF_S, _RF_BAD, _RF_OWN)
Canvas - line-drawing glyph set of a border style: corners _TC_TL/TR/BL/BR, edges _TC_HZ/_TC_VT, title caps _TC_CAP_L/R
Collapse in collapse.sh (_CL_P focus pane, _CL_G, _CL_S); in _CL_ROW/_CL_COL it is the clamped layer rectangle from _tui_layer.clamp
Content Rect - the leaf output area of a pane (_CR_R/_CR_C/_CR_H/_CR_W from _tui._content_rect)
Anchor Rect - the rectangle a layer's x / y are measured from (_AR_R/_AR_C/_AR_H/_AR_W)
Content Need - per-pane content maxima gathered in one pass during tui.render (_TUI_CN_ROW/_LEN, _TUI_CN_ON)
Widget Type - per-type contract tables of measure/draw/hit/key handlers (_TUI_WT_MEASURE/_DRAW/_HIT/_KEY)
Widget Position - state of the widget placement pass: reuse flag, last pane and its insets (_TUI_WP_*)
Inset Vertical - vertical inset widgets of one pane share (_TUI_WP_IV)
Inset Horizontal - horizontal inset widgets of one pane share (_TUI_WP_IH)
Row Cache - cache of rendered rows (_TUI_RC_*); _TUI_RC_EPOCH is bumped by every style write and page reset
Function Layers - draw functions registered with tui.layer.fn_add: _TUI_FL_ORDER, _TUI_FL_AMBIENT, _TUI_FL_TOP
Terminal Write - output chunking and the terminal-write probe (_TW_CHUNKS pieces of at most _TUI_WRITE_MAX bytes, _TR_TW)
Table - scratch of the markdown table renderer (_TB_CELLS, _TB_LINES, _TB_ALIGN)
Operation - results of markup node operations (_OP_NODES selection, _OP_CLONES, _OP_LIST, _OP_PARAMS)
Node - markup node tables indexed by node id (_N_TYPE, _N_KIDS, _N_PARENT, _N_ATTR_V, _N_BY_ID)
Shell - the page shell a page names in <tui shell=...> (_SH_OF path, _SH_NAMES engine variables a build can change)
Shell Flags - declare flags of the engine variables recorded from a `declare -p` dump (_SHL_FLAGS, _SHL_RECORD)
Scroll - scratch of pane scrolling (_SC_MAX max offset, _SC_OLD previous offset, _SC_BAR scrollbar geometry)
State - restore flag of the store (_ST_RELAYOUT: a restore moved a pane edge). In _TV_ST_* it is the validator's element Stack
Store Page - key of the page a persisted store entry belongs to (_tui_store.page -> _SP)
Store Fields - the fields a page keeps for an id (_tui_store.fields -> _SFL)
State IDs - widget and pane ids whose state the store saves and restores
Plugin - fields parsed from a plugin file header (_PL_NAME, _PL_TITLE, _PL_VER, _PL_DESC, _PL_AUTHOR, _PL_REQ, _PL_DEF)
Progress - state of the dapk command-line progress bar (_PG_LABEL, _PG_TOTAL, _PG_CUR)
Dapk Manifest - hash and children tables used while building a package manifest (_DM_HASH, _DM_KIDS, _DM_SHA)
Dapk Deps - dependency table read with keys like _DD[N.name] and _DD[N.check]
Visible Width - memo and escape-sequence patterns for the printed width of a string (_TUI_VW_MEMO, _TUI_VW_CSI/_OSC)
Visible Slice - the MAX visible columns of a line after skipping OFF, memoised (_VS, _TUI_VS_MEMO)
Visual Length - cell width of a plain string, continuation bytes not counted (_tui_md.cellw -> _VL)
Modifiers - "ctrl+alt+shift+" style prefix decoded from an xterm modifier parameter (_tui_input.mods -> _MODS)
Microseconds - integer time values (_TUI_NOW_US, _TUI_PERF_NOW_US, _JOB_FRAME_US), taken from EPOCHREALTIME
Base64 - encoded signature and key material (_B64, _SIGN_B64)
Fingerprint - key fingerprint (_SIGN_FPR, _VERIFY_FPR)
Pseudo-Terminal - how an exec widget's command is attached to a pty (_EXEC_PTY, _EXEC_PTY_KIND)
Continuous Integration - the CI system detection and its build number in packaging (_CI_PATH, _CI_ERROR)
Slurp - whole file contents in a variable, trailing newlines removed (_tui_cache_slurp -> _SLURP)
Segment - one markdown image as placeholder rows (_SEG_COLS, _SEG_ROWS, _SEG_LINES)
Image Path - the PNG a source image was converted to (_tui_md.convert -> _IMGP)
Pixel Width - width of a PNG read from its header (_PW; _PH is the height)
Pixel Height - height of a PNG read from its header (_tui_md.png_size -> _PW _PH)
Regular Expression - a pattern held in a variable for [[ =~ ]] (_TUI_MD_RE_FENCE, _TUI_MD_RE_HR, _TUI_MD_RE_LIST)
Highlight - syntax highlighting of code blocks (_TUI_MD_HL)
Pad by Characters - text cut or padded by characters, not bytes (_tui_text.padc -> _PADC)
Pad String - text cut or padded to an exact character width (_tui_cmd.pad -> _PADS)
Unescaped - attribute value with entities decoded (_tui_input.unesc -> _UNESC)
Layer Buttons - the header buttons of a layer from the right edge inward (_tui_layer.buttons -> _LB)
Snap - row/col of a layer pulled to a screen edge (_tui_layer.snap -> _SN_ROW _SN_COL)
Line Start - offset where a text widget's line begins (_tui_text.line -> _LS)
Line End - offset where a text widget's line ends (_tui_text.line -> _LE)
Context - nearest enclosing pane and row while a page is built, for nested-widget inference (_TUI_BUILD_CTX_PANE/_ROW)
Recorded - what the page cache recorded while building a page and replays instead of re-parsing (_TUI_CACHE_REC_*)
Row - suffix of a row result or field (_CR_R, _AR_R, _TXG_R, _LY_R is the layout result instead)
Column - suffix of a column result or field (_CR_C, _AR_C, _TXG_C)
Height - suffix of a height in rows (_TUI_P_H, _TUI_L_H, _CR_H); in _MANIFEST_H it is a hash
X coordinate - column of a pointer or layer position (_DLG_X, _EVENT_X, _TUI_RZ_X)
Y coordinate - row of a pointer or layer position (_DLG_Y, _EVENT_Y, _TUI_RZ_Y)
Timestamp - time of the last event of a kind (_RZ_T, _WX_CLICK_T, _TUI_RZ_LAST_T)
Findings in the validator (_TV_F_SEV/_MSG/_LOC); Flags in the layer tables (_TUI_L_F[L.flag])
